_doc: Human-entered, sourced goalscorers for matches where openfootball lags or omits events. Consulted by recapEvents() in scripts/run-stories.mjs BEFORE openfootball; each entry must agree with the confirmed FT score or it is ignored (recap holds). Goals are in our home/away terms. Every entry carries source_url + verified_by + verified_at — a score is an uncopyrightable public fact; we cite where a human read it.
